withheld.reason: Persian نباید آزرد is normative/deontic, not an ordinary assertion-negation contrast. The nē + infinitive surface does not decide function.

The selected nē abaxšāyēnd belongs to ka griyēnd, a temporal/conditional outcome in the narrated eschatological context. A general assertion analysis may be possible, but this bounded pilot leaves its contextual force unassigned rather than treating it as a simple independent factual negation.
